_about: The setup centre's choices (design §4). Models and engines are named by SOURCE (a Hugging Face repo + file patterns, a GitHub repo + asset pattern); exact files, sizes and hashes are resolved LIVE from the catalogues when the wizard shows them, so this file does not go stale. The first pattern that matches wins.
uncensored_warning: Uncensored means uncensored: these models have had their refusals and safety tuning removed. They will say and write things the standard models will not. Choose one only if that is what you want.

models.title: Gemma 4 26B-A4B (recommended)
models.about: A mixture-of-experts model: 26B parameters, about 4B active per word, so it runs well on an 8–12 GB card with the experts partly in system memory. Google's official 4-bit QAT build.

models.title: Gemma 4 31B
models.about: The dense 31B: stronger, and it needs a big card — 24 GB or more — or RunPod.

models.title: Gemma 4 26B-A4B — uncensored (HauhauCS)
models.about: The 26B-A4B with its refusals removed (HauhauCS Balanced, QAT), with a matching MTP draft model for faster replies.

models.title: Gemma 4 31B — uncensored (HauhauCS)
models.about: The dense 31B with its refusals removed (HauhauCS Balanced, QAT), with an MTP draft model. A 24 GB+ card, or RunPod.

engines.title: llama.cpp (NVIDIA, CUDA)
engines.about: The standard local engine, built for NVIDIA cards. Downloaded from llama.cpp's own releases.

engines.title: llama.cpp (any GPU, Vulkan)
engines.about: llama.cpp for AMD, Intel or NVIDIA cards through Vulkan. A little slower than CUDA on NVIDIA.

engines.title: llama.cpp (CPU only)
engines.about: No graphics card needed — slow with a 26B model, but it works.

engines.title: Kairos engine (native, NVIDIA)
engines.about: Her own engine: KV memory, byte-exact recall, the fastest MoE decode on small cards. Setup converts the model to .sp with the converter the release ships (a few minutes for the 26B). Windows + CUDA; the release with the CUDA libraries is preferred, so nothing else needs installing.
engines.profile_about: Written over sp.toml for a native profile: the settings her own stack runs the 26B-A4B with on an RTX 2060 12 GB (tested end to end 2026-11-26), KV persistence left off. sp.toml alone produced garbage with this model, and its Pmax of 4096 is shorter than a companion's system prompt. moe_cache_gb is scaled down on smaller cards (untested there).

engines.title: An engine you already run (LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM…)
engines.about: Point her at any OpenAI-compatible server. Nothing is downloaded.
